name: System Error Alert
note: Error workflow of the other n8n workflows (settings.errorWorkflow). Writes one row to platform.system_alerts; the web turns it into a health alert for managers.

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO platform.system_alerts (id, source, title, detail, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'n8n', {{ $json.title_sql }}, {{ $json.detail_sql }}, now());
